column1: # Cluster tier roster: the single source of truth for node topology.
# Copy to cluster/tiers.tsv (gitignored) and put the real host names there.
# Rows are in tier preference order (best GPU first); pick_nodes.sh walks them
# top-down. Fields are tab-separated: tier, subnet, comma-separated nodes.
# A job must never mix subnets: the cross-switch uplink caps at ~0.94 Gbps total,
# while each switch's backplane is non-blocking. Avoid mixing tiers too, since
# GPU per tier: fish RTX 3090 | birds A5000 | cars RTX 4000 Ada |
